records.original_stem:
A pharmacist is reviewing product-specific dispensing restrictions as of October 26, 2026. The question does not apply any future iPLEDGE implementation before its effective date. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_choice_text: A pharmacist requires depot-buprenorphine REMS certification before dispensing a buprenorphine pain patch.
A.finding_ko: 틀리다. BUTRANS는 통증용 transdermal 제품이며 Opioid Analgesic REMS 관련 교육·상담 안내를 가진다. BRIXADI 같은 depot-injection REMS certification을 모든 buprenorphine patch에 자동 적용하지 않는다. 어떤 REMS도 없다는 결론도 아니다.

B.original_choice_text: A pharmacist distinguishes Brixadi weekly and monthly products before processing the ordered formulation.
B.finding_ko: 맞다. weekly와 monthly는 다른 formulation이고 weekly 용량들을 합쳐 monthly equivalent로 만들 수 없다고 label이 명시한다. 처방된 formulation을 먼저 구분하는 것은 필요하다.
B.effective_date_or_version: DailyMed FDA-submitted label updated2025-12-31,revised12/2025; labeling revision not separate legal effective date

authority_evidence.effective_date_or_version: DailyMed FDA-submitted label updated2025-12-31,revised12/2025; labeling revision not separate legal effective date

C.original_choice_text: A pharmacy treats Spravato as an ordinary take-home nasal spray because nasal products are often self-administered.
C.finding_ko: 틀리다. intranasal route라도 direct healthcare-provider supervision, certified setting 및 투여 후 관찰 경로를 따른다. 일반 take-home nasal spray로 취급할 수 없다.
C.effective_date_or_version: DailyMed FDA-submitted label updated2026-09-22,revised3/2026; separate effective date unverified

authority_evidence.effective_date_or_version: DailyMed FDA-submitted label updated2026-09-22,revised3/2026; separate effective date unverified

D.original_choice_text: A pharmacist applies the TIRF outpatient enrollment process to a fentanyl transdermal patch prescription.
D.finding_ko: 틀리다. TIRF는 transmucosal immediate-release fentanyl 제품군이며 fentanyl transdermal patch가 아니다. TIRF outpatient enrollment 조건을 patch에 옮기지 않는다. FDA는2024-09-30 생산중단·신규등록중단도 설명하므로 현재 신규 enrollment 가능성을 보증하지 않는다.
